sentence: Rapid artificial intelligence integration is ____, offering immense productivity yet threatening conventional employment.
example: Rapid artificial intelligence integration is a double-edged sword, offering immense productivity yet threatening conventional employment.
translation: 인공지능의 급격한 도입은 양날의 검으로, 엄청난 생산성을 제공하지만 기존 고용을 위협하기도 한다.

sentence: Renewable energy adoption will ____ mitigating global greenhouse gas emissions over the next two decades.
example: Renewable energy adoption will play a pivotal role in mitigating global greenhouse gas emissions over the next two decades.
translation: 재생에너지 도입은 향후 20년 동안 전 세계 온실가스 배출을 완화하는 데 중추적인 역할을 할 것이다.

sentence: Unregulated industrial expansion frequently occurs ____ long-term environmental sustainability and public health.
example: Unregulated industrial expansion frequently occurs at the expense of long-term environmental sustainability and public health.
translation: 규제 없는 산업 확장은 종종 장기적인 환경 지속가능성과 공공 보건을 희생시키며 일어난다.

sentence: To resolve intricate socio-economic disparities, policymakers must encourage researchers to ____.
example: To resolve intricate socio-economic disparities, policymakers must encourage researchers to think outside the box.
translation: 복잡한 사회경제적 불평등을 해결하기 위해 정책 입안자들은 연구자들이 기존의 틀에서 벗어나 창의적으로 생각하도록 장려해야 한다.

idiom: tip the scales in favor of
sentence: Her extensive international volunteering experience helped ____ during the fiercely competitive scholarship selection.
example: Her extensive international volunteering experience helped tip the scales in favor of during the fiercely competitive scholarship selection.
translation: 그녀의 폭넓은 해외 봉사 경험은 치열한 장학금 선발 과정에서 그녀에게 유리하도록 작용했다.

sentence: Breakthroughs in genetic sequencing will undoubtedly ____ personalized therapies for previously incurable genetic disorders.
example: Breakthroughs in genetic sequencing will undoubtedly pave the way for personalized therapies for previously incurable genetic disorders.
translation: 유전자 서열 분석의 획기적인 발전은 의심할 여지 없이 이전에는 불치였던 유전 질환에 대한 맞춤형 치료의 발판을 마련할 것이다.
